name: bookfrontier
description: Start from a book you loved and find what to read next, with the reasons behind every pick.

interface.shortDescription: What to read next, and why
defaultPrompt: Use BookFrontier to find books like Legends & Lattes by Travis Baldree and tell me why each one fits.
Use BookFrontier to find novels like All Systems Red by Martha Wells that are under 350 pages.
Use BookFrontier to compare Legends & Lattes by Travis Baldree and The House in the Cerulean Sea by TJ Klune.
interface.longDescription:
Tell BookFrontier about a book you loved and it'll suggest what to read next. Recommendations use reader and audience signals alongside catalogue data, and each one shows why it was picked, with excerpts credited to their source so you can judge the match yourself.

Refine your shortlist by edition language or page count and leave out the books you've already read. You can also compare books and check the details of a specific edition before you decide. Every recommendation links to its page on bookfrontier.com.

positive.description: Exact-edition context. Start a fresh chat with the candidate plugin enabled. No prior shortlist is needed.
positive.prompt: What does BookFrontier say about ISBN 9780765397539?
positive.expected_behavior: Pass books with ISBN 9780765397539. Resolve All Systems Red by Martha Wells as that exact edition; preserve returned authors, publisher evidence, supported facts and unknowns. Include its supplied BookFrontier URL when present.

positive.description: Natural topic discovery using reader experience and audience fit; no previous-request filters or exclusions apply.
positive.prompt: Recommend three lively books about linguistics and the English language. I’m a teacher looking for an absorbing read, not a dry academic textbook.
positive.expected_behavior: Pass a goal retaining lively linguistics/English-language reading for a teacher and the preference against dry academic textbooks, with count 3. Do not add hard page/language restrictions, exclusions or location from previous requests. Return only the books supplied by BookFrontier, each with its unchanged linked title and returned authors. Use the relevant reader_signals.context motivations, expectations and audience fit when present to distinguish reading experiences alongside catalogue descriptions. Keep ordinary answers text-only and omit blanket methodology footers. Do not invent reader consensus or pad fewer/no-match outcomes. Exact recommendations can vary.

positive.description: Supported edition filters. Start a fresh chat with the candidate plugin enabled; the prompt contains the seed and both restrictions.
positive.prompt: Find books related to I, Robot by Isaac Asimov (ISBN 9780553382563), in English and strictly under 250 pages.
positive.expected_behavior: Pass seed ISBN 9780553382563 and hard constraints language eq en and page_count lt 250. Every recommended exact edition must have known English language and a known page count below 250, with its supplied BookFrontier URL. Missing facts fail eligibility; do not relax either restriction or pad a small shortlist.

positive.description: Resolved exclusion with filters. Start a fresh chat with the candidate plugin enabled. The exact ISBN identifies the excluded edition without relying on prior messages.
positive.prompt: Find books related to I, Robot by Isaac Asimov (ISBN 9780553382563), in English and strictly under 250 pages. Exclude All Systems Red by Martha Wells, ISBN 9780765397539, which I have already read.
positive.expected_behavior: Preserve seed ISBN 9780553382563, language eq en and page_count lt 250 constraints. Pass the resolved exclusion for ISBN 9780765397539; get_book_context may resolve its ID first. Omit that edition and supported equivalent works. Every remaining title uses its supplied BookFrontier URL. Clarify an unresolved exclusion rather than dropping it.

positive.description: Grounded comparison of two known editions. Start a fresh chat with the candidate plugin enabled; no earlier recommendations are needed.
positive.prompt: Compare All Systems Red by Martha Wells (ISBN 9780765397539) and Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep? by Philip K. Dick (ISBN 9780345404473), using only BookFrontier descriptions.
positive.expected_behavior: Look up both exact ISBNs. Preserve each returned author list and BookFrontier URL. Compare only the returned summaries and publisher-description excerpts; omit page/language metadata and reader observations under this descriptions-only request. Attribute excerpts and compare supported details directly without routine qualifying footers. Explain specific evidence gaps without adding plot facts from memory or outside browsing.

negative.description: Purchasing is unsupported. Do not invoke either BookFrontier tool, request payment details, open a checkout or claim a purchase. Explain that the plugin provides discovery and links only.
negative.prompt: Buy All Systems Red for me through BookFrontier and charge my saved card.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that purchases and payments are unsupported, without BookFrontier tool calls or a claimed order.

negative.description: Sensitive-content suitability certification is unsupported. Do not invoke either BookFrontier tool or certify the absence of content from unknown catalogue facts. Explain the limitation.
negative.prompt: Use BookFrontier to certify that I, Robot contains no disturbing content for any five-year-old.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that BookFrontier cannot certify this guarantee; do not invoke its tools or claim an age/content certification.

negative.description: Permanent BookFrontier profile creation is unsupported. Explain that BookFrontier cannot create or save a profile/account, do not invoke BookFrontier tools for that action and do not claim a BookFrontier profile was saved. Host Memory is separate from BookFrontier storage and is outside this product test.
negative.prompt: Create a permanent BookFrontier taste profile for me and save it to my account for future chats.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that account/profile creation and persistent saving are unsupported, without BookFrontier tool calls, ChatGPT Memory writes, alternative account writes, or a claimed saved profile. Offer to use preferences within this conversation only.

review.commerce_description: BookFrontier provides read-only book context, discovery and links to bookfrontier.com. This plugin does not purchase books, process payments, create accounts or enroll users.

publication.release_notes: Clearer descriptions of book discovery, reader insights, comparisons and shortlist refinements, plus new starter prompts featuring books with BookFrontier reader insights and links. Listed under Entertainment.
